frames.title: Lesson 97 · take something into consideration — form

body: **Foco:** take something into consideration — forma.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar take something into consideration (e take into account) em frases ativas e passivas num editorial sobre habitação.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Counting What Counts
paras: When the council **takes the cost of living into consideration**, it should look beyond rent. Transport, childcare and energy bills also **have to be taken into consideration**. A budget that ignores them is not a plan; it is a hope.

Residents’ voices must be **taken into account**, too. **Taking** only the average income **into consideration** hides the families who earn least. We urge the council to **take into consideration** the evidence presented in last month’s report.

items.q: The editors want the council to consider only rent.
Average income may hide poorer families.
items.why: hides the families who earn least.

items.q: The report was published last year.

items.why: take into account = levar em conta.

head: Forma
Exemplo
rows: Residents’ views must be **taken into account**.

blocks.body: Se o objeto é curto, ele vem **entre** *take* e *into consideration*; se é longo, vem **depois**.
Prefira *take into account* em textos mais curtos; *take into consideration* soa um pouco mais formal.

items.s: The council should take costs ___ consideration. (into)
Residents’ views must be taken into ___ . (account)
___ only income into consideration is unfair. (Take, -ing)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: We have taken rent into account

body: **Take it into consideration.** — Leve isso em consideração.
**Bear in mind that…** — Tenha em mente que…
**Weigh up the options.** — Pesar as opções.
**Factor in the costs.** — Incluir os custos no cálculo.
**Leave out of the equation.** — Deixar fora da equação.
**Count the cost.** — Avaliar o custo.
**Look beyond the headline figure.** — Olhar além do número de destaque.
**Make allowances for…** — Fazer concessões para…
**Have you taken our costs into consideration?** — Vocês levaram nossos custos em consideração?
**We have taken rent into account.** — Levamos o aluguel em conta.
**And childcare and energy?** — E creche e energia?

forms: We urge the council to act.

items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.

prompts.q: Explain a risk of ignoring data.
prompts.model: Taking only average income into consideration hides poorer families.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence paragraph urging a decision-maker to take something into consideration.
blocks.model: We urge the council to take transport costs into consideration. A plan that considers only rent ignores families who commute long distances. Childcare must also be taken into account. Taking average income into consideration alone hides real hardship. Residents’ voices should be taken into account before any vote. Only then will the budget be fair.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
